subject: infoschema: use the cloned structure instead of the original structure when applying diff (#62284)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. `applyModifySchemaCharsetAndCollateV2` / `applyModifySchemaDefaultPlacementV2` now clone the existing v2 `DBInfo` before mutation, preventing cross-schema-version (txn snapshot) metadata contamination when applying schema diffs; regression test added for #62253 covering charset + placement-policy changes under schema-cache v2. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; later history up to `upstream/master` does not modify these specific apply-diff paths.
